intro.text: One of Lopen's uncles, a talkative man with an ugly broken toe.

items.text: Chilinko lived in Sebarial's warcamp. In 1173 he helped Lopen hide King Elhokar at Lopen's mother's home after the attempt on the king's life, and passed on Sebarial's order to prepare to evacuate. When Lopen learned to draw in Stormlight, he called Chilinko back to stick him to a wall, and Chilinko was shocked to see Lopen's arm growing back.
